title: Define intake contract, compatibility signals, and staged pinning for ephemeral open-model submissions
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: PRD summary: Clarify the acceptance contract and runtime compatibility signals required to onboard ephemeral or community-submitted open model weights into the Redwood catalog. Establish a staged pinning approach (softpin -> observation -> hardpin) and explicit compatibility metadata fields that allow the runtime and console to make safe routing/fallback decisions without blocking fast experimentation.
background: We routinely receive short-lived community builds and experimental checkpoints that teams want discoverable in the catalog for testing. Current intake is binary: either pin a variant to runtime or keep it unlisted. That creates operational risk (unknown kernel/quantization behavior) and poor discoverability. We need a lightweight, low-friction intake contract for ephemeral weights that preserves safety and gives runtime engineers signals to route or block traffic.
goals: 1) Define the minimal metadata surface required for safe admission of ephemeral open weights. 2) Specify staged pinning semantics and transitions. 3) Provide concrete acceptance criteria and automated checks for admission. 4) Define console UX flags and runtime routing behaviors tied to compatibility signals.
non_goals: 1) Do not change the pinned-model SLA or infra for Dedicated customers. 2) This ticket does not implement kernel-level compatibility tests — it defines the contract and test harness requirements. 3) No changes to pricing/quoting for experimental models.
requirements:
- Intake metadata fields: architecture (string), training_config_hash (string), tokenizer_id (string), quantization_supported (enum: none/int8/q4/q8), kv_cache_compatible (boolean as string: "true"/"false"), max_sequence_known (int as string), exemplar_prompt_set_id (string).
- Compatibility signals: runtime_profile_tag (auto-generated by infra), inference_smoke_status (pass/warn/fail), tokenizer_roundtrip_ratio (float as string), memory_estimate_bytes (string).
- Staged pinning flow: 'softpin' (visible in catalog, routing excluded from default traffic), 'observation' (allowed small traffic percentage with telemetry), 'hardpin' (eligible for production routing per pin rules). Each transition requires automated checks (see acceptance criteria).
- Console: show compatibility badges (green/yellow/red) and a clear disclaimer for ephemeral variants describing fallback behavior.
- API: expose a model_metadata endpoint returning the fields above and a 'pin_state' string.
- Intake UI: single-click submit with required fields plus optional test artifacts (example prompts, sample outputs, training provenance link).
- Automated checks: stateless size check, tokenizer roundtrip validation, simple generate smoke tests with canonical prompts, and an inference latency/sample cost estimate.
- Governance: intake creates a short-lived audit record with submitter email and link to provenance; retention window 90 days for ephemeral variants.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted ephemeral weight with required metadata, the registry accepts and creates an entry in 'softpin' state
Given missing required metadata, intake returns a meaningful validation error referencing field docs
Given a softpinned model, default runtime routing excludes it from user-facing endpoints unless explicitly targeted
Given the observation traffic rule (default 0.5% traffic), runtime can route observation traffic and collect latency/error/quality metrics
Transition from softpin->observation is allowed only when inference_smoke_status != fail and tokenizer_roundtrip_ratio >= 0.95
Transition from observation->hardpin requires automated quality regression check against a baseline eval set and sign-off by a runtime owner
Console shows compatibility badge and a tooltip explaining each signal and remediation suggestions
Model metadata endpoint returns all specified fields and a consistent 'pin_state' value
All checks produce structured logs and a dashboardable metric so SRE and product can monitor intake health
test_plan:
- Unit: schema validation for intake endpoint and CI tests for each required metadata field.
- Integration: automated intake pipeline test including smoke generate and tokenizer roundtrip.
- Staging: seed 3 ephemeral models, verify softpin listing, observation traffic, metric collection, and state transitions.
- Canary: route observation traffic for one internally-approved model to production debug tier for 48 hours.
- Ops runbook: rollback steps to demote observation->softpin and remove from catalog.
decisions:
- We will treat kv_cache_compatible as an explicit opt-in flag from submitters; runtime may still override after automated profiling.
- Default observation traffic = 0.5% (configurable per project).
- Ephemeral entries expire after 90 days unless promoted to hardpin.
- We will not require KMS or enterprise-only security scans at intake; those are required for hardpinning later.
risks_mitigations:
- Risk: Bad community weights cause runtime instability. Mitigation: block routing for softpin and require automated smoke tests before observation.
- Risk: Submitters misreport metadata. Mitigation: token roundtrip and hash checks during intake.
- Risk: Increased catalog noise. Mitigation: UX filters and expiration policy.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge contract spec and schema change to registry (week 1). 2) Implement intake UI and API + CI checks (week 2-3). 3) Add observation routing code and metrics (week 4). 4) Staging validation with seeded models (week 5). 5) Soft rollout to internal projects, then public (week 6).
notes: Design asked for an explanations panel; we decided to add compatibility badges first and iterate. Runtime owners requested an override switch for emergency demotion of observation models. We should schedule a 30-minute sync with SRE and Runtime next week.
customer_notes: This flow is targeted at experimentation and discovery. Enterprise customers will still use Dedicated/Private pinning paths for production guarantees.
audit_requirements: Create intake audit entry with submitter identity and provenance URL; store pointer in compliance index for 90 days

notes_for_engineering: Expose a new model_metadata endpoint and store the compatibility signals as first-class columns. Ensure schema is backward compatible with existing pinned model rows.
implementation_constraints: Keep intake path idempotent; max request size 10MB for sample artifacts; retention of ephemeral artifacts limited to 90 days.
